title: Evidence bounds every promotion claim
description: The evidence ladder separates source and architecture facts, component numerics, admitted artifacts and deployments, runtime lifecycle, whole-model execution, quality evaluation, benchmark and release. Each stronger claim needs its own evidence; lower-level success does not imply any later stage. This is a qualification discipline, not a statement that every gate is complete.

panels.title: a  Increasing claim strength — not a build schedule
b  A successful lower gate never fills a later gap
